git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/source_only.py, git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/coral.py, git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/mmd.py, and git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/cdan.py show experiment run methods accept resume_from paths, making this reachable from runtime inputs.
